mustPreserve.description: Remain read-only unless remediation is separately requested and approved.
Use the strongest safe reliable parse, compile, scenario, or runtime check.
Require explicit run and live gates for networked execution.
Report raw-block and scenario evidence separately.

mustFix.description: Emit normalized status, exit code, digest, diagnostics, and artifacts.
Order diagnostics by stable code and target identity.

forbidden.description: Never execute unannotated or unapproved snippets.

positiveTriggers.prompt: Compile and scenario-check every snippet in this document.

negativeTriggers.prompt: Draft the surrounding guide from product notes.
